name: Aura
author: Donovan Burbano
description: ASUS Aura keyboard lighting: firmware effects, theme sync, and an audio-reactive music mode.

barWidget.description: Keyboard lighting control: brightness, firmware effects, colours, theme sync, and music mode.

schema.label: Follow theme colour
schema.description: Use the Omarchy theme's keyboard colour instead of a hand-picked one. It is a colour source, not a mode: it composes with every effect, music included. Picked in the panel via the theme chip in the colour row.

schema.label: Music mode
schema.description: Audio-reactive effect. Selected from the Mode list in the panel, alongside the firmware effects, since only one thing can animate the keyboard at a time.

schema.label: Music smoothing
schema.description: How slowly the lighting falls back after a peak (60 ms at 1, 600 ms at 10). This is the knob for flicker.

schema.label: Music refresh rate (Hz)
schema.description: Keyboard updates per second while music mode runs. The device sustains ~83 Hz; 25 is smooth and cheap.
